pairs.subject: audit-logging
pairs.evidence: src/lib/db/scans-audit.ts:34 The audit writer persists arbitrary caller metadata after signing without sanitization or size limits, allowing sensitive values to become durable audit evidence.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/db/retention.ts:1525 The erasure path updates existing audit rows and re-signs their replacement metadata, violating the standard's prohibition on in-place mutation; claim release itself now correctly appends a record.

prisma/schema.prisma:879 Subject references reside in JSON metadata rather than structured indexed columns; the inspected API and getAuditLog support action, actor and time filters but provide no subject filter.

src/lib/db/audit-health.ts:30 Failed writes are now counted and surfaced, but accounting exists only in process memory and resets on restart, falling short of the required durable counter by ledger and failure class.

src/lib/db/org-decisions.ts:264 Security decisions have separate mutable state and stable finding keys, but their audit acts omit the previous status, rationale and contemporaneous title, so overwriting state loses essential decision history.
src/lib/db/scans-audit.ts:363 This action ledger ranges over its single insertion timestamp; it has no recorded/invalidated validity interval requiring a bitemporal replay predicate.

src/lib/db/retention.ts:1034 Scheduled purging applies one org-wide horizon across all audit actions, while inserts perform no retention enforcement; safety floors and post-deletion self-records do not supply domain-specific admission-time bounds.

src/features/admin/audit/AuditLogTable.tsx:30 HMAC verification runs on read and exports carry verdicts, but the dashboard hides integrity status when no signing key exists instead of explicitly showing that the trail is unverifiable.

src/lib/db/scans-persist.ts:803 The inspected audit writes record actions performed here, such as scan persistence and human decisions; live advisory totals are not ingested as historical audit events requiring a separate effective clock.

src/lib/db/scans-recommendations.ts:158 Recommendation mutations insert directly into AuditLog, as do scan persistence and conformance reporting; shared signing does not establish one insert door enforcing every ledger invariant.
src/lib/db/scans-audit.ts:30 Caller metadata passes directly to a signature helper that preserves its values, with no write-path allowlist, secret scrubbing or payload cap before insertion.
